ignoreCommand: prev="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-}"; [ -n "$prev" ] || exit 1; git cat-file -e "$prev^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$prev" HEAD -- nexo-one nexo-atlas api vercel.json ':(exclude)nexo-one/tower-head.json' ':(exclude)nexo-one/tcc-public-inbox-ack.json'
installCommand: cd nexo-one && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && cd ../nexo-atlas && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts
buildCommand: cd nexo-one && npm run build && cd ../nexo-atlas && npm run build:private && node scripts/build-vercel-shell.mjs
